description:
Use Gumtree in ChatGPT to search and view items for sale in your local area or shop completely online with our integrated payment and delivery. Browse matching results, compare key details, and open listings on Gumtree to continue with actions such as messaging sellers, posting an Ad, or online shopping.

Try prompts like this:
· @Gumtree, I am looking for a BMW 3 series for less than £8,000. Manual and ideally less than 30 miles from London
· @Gumtree, I’m moving home and need a sofa, a wardrobe and dining table. Show me options from sellers in Bath.
· @Gumtree I am selling my gaming gear to fund a new console. How much can I get for my PS5?

Want to take a more hands-on approach? Download the Gumtree app and browse millions of items for your home, used cars ads, and even local services and property listings.
